parameter_set.description: PyBaMM 26.10.1.1's NCA_Kim2011 parameter set, for a nominal-design graphite/NCA pouch cell (Kim et al. 2011). Exported to BPX by battinfo-records (scripts/export-pybamm-bpx.py).

notes: Parameter values from https://doi.org/10.1149/1.3597614 as implemented in PyBaMM's NCA_Kim2011 parameter set (PyBaMM 26.10.1.1, BSD-3-Clause), exported to BPX by battinfo-records.
Matches PyBaMM 26.10.1.1's native set within 0.12 mV RMS and 0.013% capacity (DFN discharges at 0.2C, 1C, 2C and 1C 20 K warmer).
The electrolyte conductivity does not follow an Arrhenius law (activation energies spread over 17715 J/mol).
The electrolyte diffusivity does not follow an Arrhenius law (activation energies spread over 8478 J/mol).
